import requests, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json

def fetch(u,p):
    if not(os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p)>500):
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=300); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"wb").write(r.content)
    return p
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V

ls=B62.strip().split("\n"); hdr=ls[0].split(); AAi={a:k for k,a in enumerate(hdr)}
M62=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): M62[AAi[p[0]],AAi[b]]=int(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([AAi.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw_fast(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2); S=M62[np.ix_(e1,e2)]; NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Xx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Yy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Xx[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge; PX[i,0]=1
    Yy[0,1:]=go+np.arange(m)*ge; PY[0,1:]=2
    ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm,px,py=Mm[i-1],Xx[i-1],Yy[i-1]
        st=np.vstack([pm[:-1],px[:-1],py[:-1]]); k=st.argmax(0); Mm[i,1:]=st[k,ar]+S[i-1]; PM[i,1:]=k
        s2v=np.vstack([pm[1:]+go,px[1:]+ge,py[1:]+go]); k2=s2v.argmax(0); Xx[i,1:]=s2v[k2,ar]; PX[i,1:]=k2
        cm,cx,cy=Mm[i],Xx[i],Yy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o0=cm[j-1]+go;o1=cx[j-1]+go;o2=cy[j-1]+ge
            if o0>=o1 and o0>=o2: cy[j]=o0;PY[i,j]=0
            elif o1>=o2: cy[j]=o1;PY[i,j]=1
            else: cy[j]=o2;PY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; s=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Xx[n,m],Yy[n,m]])); pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if s==0: pr.append((i,j)); s=PM[i,j]; i-=1;j-=1
        elif s==1: s=PX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: s=PY[i,j]; j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def useq(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
orth=json.loads('{"C. briggsae":"A0AAE9E160","C. remanei":"A0A261BES2","C. brenneri":"G0N7K4","C. japonica":"A0A8R1DTN5","P. pacificus":"A0A2A6BCJ2","B. malayi":"A0A4E9EUW8","D. melanogaster":"Q9VFL0","H. sapiens":"Q8TDR0","M. musculus":"Q149C2","D. rerio":"Q6PGZ3","X. tropicalis":"B3DLT2","C. reinhardtii":"A8JBY2","T. thermophila":"Q24FQ8","T. brucei":"Q38CJ3","S. purpuratus":"A0A7M7PT16","C. intestinalis":"F7BNX7","P. tetraurelia":"A0BFP5"}')
dyf=useq("Q17595"); L=len(dyf)
seqs={k:useq(a) for k,a in orth.items()}
ident=np.zeros(L); cov=np.zeros(L); per_sp={}
for sp,s in seqs.items():
    tot_i=0; tot_n=0
    for (qlo,qhi),(tlo,thi) in [((0,140),(0,190)),((399,L),(len(s)-220,len(s)))]:
        q=dyf[qlo:qhi]; t=s[tlo:thi]
        pr=nw_fast(q,t)
        for i,j in pr:
            cov[qlo+i-1]+=1
            if q[i-1]==t[j-1]: ident[qlo+i-1]+=1
    per_sp[sp]=None
frac=np.where(cov>0, ident/np.maximum(cov,1), np.nan)
